description: Fetch normalized job postings from a PUBLIC ATS board you already have the ats + board_token for (use ats_detect or ats_company_jobs if you only have a domain). Returns {found:false, reason:"board_not_found"} for an unknown board — never an empty jobs[] for that case. Lever/Ashby/BambooHR/Recruitee/Teamtailor/Breezy DO distinguish a real zero-job board (found:true, jobs:[]) from an unknown one; SmartRecruiters cannot (ambiguous:true); Pinpoint and iCIMS have not had a confirmed-empty real board observed live, so a 0-job result from those two is NOT independently confirmed to mean "real board, no jobs" versus a mis-detected token. Workday board_token is "<tenant>.wd<N>/<site>" (e.g. "workday.wd5/Workday"); its response states capped:true if your limit/offset hit Workday's own pagination limits (limit<=20, offset<=10000). Workable is currently blocked by Cloudflare from this platform's edge and will throw a loud error naming the 429, not an empty result. Dover is NOT supported: its public board is a Cloudflare-Turnstile-gated SPA with no keyless jobs endpoint.

board_token.description: The board identifier: Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby/SmartRecruiters/Teamtailor/Personio/Breezy/Pinpoint company slug or subdomain label; Recruitee/BambooHR subdomain label; Jobvite slug (path segment after jobs.jobvite.com/); Rippling slug (path segment after ats.rippling.com/); iCIMS full subdomain label before .icims.com (e.g. "careers-acme" — prefixes vary by customer); Workable account slug; Workday "<tenant>.wd<N>/<site>".

filters.description: Optional post-fetch filters and Workday pagination controls.

limit.description: Workday only: page size, clamped to 20 (Workday itself rejects anything higher with HTTP 400).

offset.description: Workday only: pagination offset, clamped to 10000 (Workday's own cap).

region.description: Lever only: "eu" queries api.eu.lever.co instead of api.lever.co.

remote_only.description: Keep only jobs flagged remote (where the ATS reports it).

title_query.description: Case-insensitive substring match on job title. For Workday this is also sent upstream as the search text.

name: ats_jobs
